kept.name: TestBootstrapStage_ConstantsAreDistinctAndZeroValued
kept.reason: pins the bootstrap stage constants being distinct with bootstrapStageNone the zero value; no behavior test asserts the enumeration

kept.name: TestBootstrapVerb
kept.reason: pins BootstrapVerb being exactly start and equal to the Use of the command startCmd builds, so a rename cannot leave the constant behind; the covering test never reads the constant

kept.name: TestConsumeHandoffVoucher
kept.reason: pins the voucher matching only on an equal history length and state, a grown history, a changed state or an absent voucher not matching, and the voucher being deleted on every read; the observe-entry test covers only the matching, one-shot case

kept.name: TestDriverReportPath
kept.reason: pins the report path composed under the drive-reports directory with a timestamp ahead of the random part, differing across two calls under a frozen clock and deterministic under a fixed rand; the covering integration test only runs the composer

kept.name: TestDriverResumeLine
kept.reason: pins the resume line naming the run-id, the report path, the baseline and budget instructions, and being a non-empty single line; the covering test sends the line without asserting its text

kept.name: TestDriverSpec
kept.reason: pins every field of the driver launch spec: prompt, the empty skill list, the report as its single output file, the resolved model, effort and version, the name override, role, display anchor and the zero-valued fields; it names Spec.Skills, so the skills-in-one-turn task owns it, and its covering test runs the spec without asserting the fields

kept.name: TestFindStatusStrand
kept.reason: pins the status strand lookup by exact name and by full agent name, and a name that is only a prefix not matching; its covering tests resolve the strand action without asserting the lookup

kept.name: TestGenericVerbs_AcceptOptionalRunIDPositional
kept.reason: pins run, step, status, pause and goto each accepting zero or one positional run-id and refusing two; its covering test builds the tree without asserting argument counts

kept.name: TestLandingDeps_EveryFieldPopulated
kept.reason: drift guard walking every landingshed.Deps field by reflection so a field added later must be populated; the covering mark-done test populates only the fields it uses

kept.name: TestMustSpawnDriver
kept.reason: pins the spawn predicate over the run lock, the driver lock and the live driver strand, including the mixed rows a lock-only predicate fails; its covering tests run the predicate without asserting its table

kept.name: TestMustUseLLMDriverArm
kept.reason: pins the go and empty driver values selecting the detached-spawn arm and the llm value the strand launch; its covering test runs the llm arm without asserting the switch

kept.name: TestNewCommitStatusSeam_OrdinaryPath
kept.reason: pins the seam with no board-status writer calling commit then spawn once each, in that order, and spawning nothing for a no-op commit; the board-status test always installs a writer

kept.name: TestNewDriverReportRand_ProducesFourHexChars
kept.reason: pins the production random source returning four lowercase hex characters; its covering test passes a stub source instead

kept.name: TestNewLoomCLI_SetsInjectedSeams
kept.reason: pins newLoomCLI setting spawnWatchdog, midMerge, recordedParentBranch and suppressWatchdogSpawn, fields the constructor's callers do not expose; its covering tests build the CLI without asserting them

kept.name: TestPlanFindingsHaveBlocking_UnrecognizedSeverityFailsClosed
kept.reason: pins loomcli's half of the fail-closed severity classification: the zero value and an unrecognized severity block, informational passes; the gate parity test compares verdicts over fixtures with recognized severities only

kept.name: TestProductionFiles_LoomCLILiteralOnlyInFactory
kept.reason: scans the package's production files for a loomCLI composite literal outside newLoomCLI's file, a source-shape guard no behavior test reaches

kept.name: TestReflectFrictionRow
kept.reason: pins an empty friction directory never reflecting and a set one attempting the reflection, recorded on the receiver; the covering test waits on the lock rather than asserting the skip

kept.name: TestReflectFrictionRow_SpawnsThroughTheReflectionShuttle
kept.reason: pins the row reflecting through the reflection shuttle: one spawn whose prompt names the note, the note archived out of the friction directory and the status reported as reflected; the covering tests reflect over a deps failure that never spawns

kept.name: TestReflectFriction_DepsValidationFailureReportsFailed
kept.reason: pins a malformed deps value reporting failed rather than an error or a filed status, and the reflection lock being released for the next call; the covering tests reflect through other paths

kept.name: TestResolveDriverStrandAction
kept.reason: pins the driver strand action over every strand shape: none, status-only, live, dead, retiring, full-name and legacy-named; its covering tests resolve it without asserting each arm

kept.name: TestResumeParkedDriver
kept.reason: pins the resume send: one single-line message naming the drive-reports directory and the marker removed on success, waits through a not-ready pane, the attempt bound, and a non-readiness error never retried, with the marker kept on refusal; the covering tests assert the outcome of the resume, not each send

kept.name: TestRunDriverSpawnAndWait_DeadDriverWithStaleMarkerRemovesItAndSpawns
kept.reason: pins a dead driver strand with a stale park marker removing the marker and spawning a fresh driver with no resume line sent; the covering tests neither park a marker nor assert its removal

kept.name: TestRunDriverSpawnAndWait_LLMArm_NeverConsultsTheRunLockHandshake
kept.reason: pins the llm arm never consulting the go arm's run-lock handshake, the deliberate asymmetry between the arms that a later unifying refactor would break; the covering test counts no handshake calls

kept.name: TestRunDriverSpawnAndWait_LiveParkedDriverIsResumedNotSpawned
kept.reason: pins a live parked driver being resumed with one line, its marker removed, no handoff voucher written and no refusal recorded, without spawning; the covering tests assert the refusal and spawn paths

kept.name: TestRunDriverSpawnAndWait_MidMerge_CleanPairProceeds
kept.reason: pins the mid-merge probe running exactly once on a clean pair before the starter is reached; its covering test uses a probe that counts nothing

kept.name: TestRunDriverSpawnAndWait_MidMerge_LiveWorkingDriverNotProbed
kept.reason: pins a live working driver, running or halted at hand-back, never reaching the mid-merge probe; the covering test never counts probe calls

kept.name: TestScanFileForDriverFieldReads_StampsTheEnclosingFunction
kept.reason: pins the driver-field scan telling two readers in one file apart by enclosing function, which the carve-out key relies on; the repo-wide scan asserts only that no reader sits outside

kept.name: TestSeedSlug
kept.reason: pins seedSlug returning the worktree name unchanged and empty for an empty name; the covering test reaches it without asserting the result

kept.name: TestSpecFor_ScratchAndFrictionDir
kept.reason: pins specFor's scratch directory from the location and run-id, the friction directory passed through, and a nil location giving no scratch directory; its covering tests run specFor without asserting those fields

kept.name: TestSpecFor_WaitingHookNilWithoutLocation
kept.reason: pins the status spec carrying no waiting hook when the CLI has no location; its covering tests build the spec without asserting its hooks

kept.name: TestStartLLMDriverArm
kept.reason: pins the llm arm composing the started spec and addressing the run by slug, removing a dead corpse before the start, and propagating a starter or corpse-removal error without reaching the starter; the covering tests drive the arm through the whole bootstrap without asserting the spec

kept.name: TestStatusCommitPathspec
kept.reason: pins the status commit pathspec naming the status file always and the reviews, loom durable and drive-reports directories only once they hold a file; the covering integration test commits one fixed layout

kept.name: TestStepEnvelope_NextInterruptPolicyMatchesTable
kept.reason: pins next_interrupt_policy against the interrupt-policy table over a reinvoke row, the handback row and an empty next; the covering step tests assert other envelope keys

kept.name: TestValidateDescriptionCmd
kept.reason: pins validate-description's envelope: the description path on success and the Co-Authored-By finding with a non-zero exit; the parity test compares verdicts alone

kept.name: TestValidateDiscussionCmd
kept.reason: pins validate-discussion's exit code, ok value and findings key and text over a clean record, an absent support log, a missing heading, an unreadable decision record, a malformed relevant list and an unreadable relevant list, and a Record-Write run's empty commit count, dropped added entry and disregard of a malformed relevant list; the parity test compares verdicts alone

kept.name: TestValidatePlanCmd_QuarryUnavailableNamesQuarry
kept.reason: pins a quarry-unavailable failure surfacing as an error envelope naming quarry rather than the plan; no other case makes quarry unavailable

kept.name: TestValidatePlanCmd_ReworkReportsFindingsForFirstCardMismatch
kept.reason: pins the --rework verb printing the rework-first-card finding when first_card differs from the committed plan's next card number

kept.name: TestWireLightweight_FillsThePathsWithoutLoadingAnyConfig
kept.reason: pins the lightweight wiring filling the status, lock and plan-validation paths and the commit-status seam with no config loaded and no engine built; the covering test runs the wiring without asserting its fields

kept.name: TestWire_FrictionDirFillsBurlerAndWebster
kept.reason: pins the resolved friction directory filled into c.frictionDir, the webster run deps and its env copy when the friction key is set, and the empty string in all three when it is present but empty; the covering test wires with the default config only
